name: Alex's Caves
description: Alex's Caves hides six huge biomes underground.

pages.title: Alex's Caves
pages.text:
[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **Key points**

- Six huge, rare underground biomes with their own mobs, blocks and hazards.
- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() A **Cave Biome Map** finds the nearest one.
- [#](FFFFFF)[#]() Toxic Caves' Acid and Purple Soda are **bottomless** fluids.
- Off here: the Subterranodon, and crafting the small Submarine.
**Alex's Caves** hides six huge biomes underground. Each has its own creatures, blocks and hazards. They are rare, so the mod gives you a way to locate them.

The six biomes:

- **Magnetic Caves**
- **Primordial Caves**: dinosaurs, minus the rideable Subterranodon
- **Toxic Caves**: acid and uranium
- **Abyssal Chasm**: a deep water trench
- **Forlorn Hollows**
- **Candy Cavity**

**Where they are.** Five of the six lie deep under land far from the sea: Primordial Caves under fairly inland ground, and Magnetic Caves, Toxic Caves, Forlorn Hollows and Candy Cavity under the most inland ground of all. The Abyssal Chasm lies under deep ocean.

None starts within 400 blocks of world spawn (Toxic Caves and Forlorn Hollows: 650). Expect the nearest of each to be a few thousand blocks away, so a Cave Biome Map is worth crafting before you set out.

pages.title: Spelunkery Table
pages.text: Where [Cave Tablets](item://alexscaves:cave_tablet) are studied. Place a tablet in the slot to begin research.

pages.title: Cave Biome Map
pages.text: A map pointing to the nearest cave biome of a type. If none is near, travel far away and try again.

Toxic Caves are the Create-connected one. Acid and Purple Soda are marked in Create's own data as **bottomless** fluids, like water and lava, so a hose pulley can draw them without running dry.\
\
See [#](2E5AAC)[Fluids](entry://create_basics/fluids)[#]().

pages.title: Uranium Rod
pages.text: Alex's Caves has its own uranium and a Nuclear Furnace. It is separate content from Create Nuclear, so check [#](7A3C9A)[JEI](entry://glossary/jei)[#]() before mixing them.

**Magnetic Caves** add Magnetic Levitation Rail and Neodymium nodes.\
\
The **Abyssal Chasm** is a deep water trench under the ocean, best reached in a [#](2E5AAC)[Deep Seas](entry://ocean/submarines)[#]() submarine.

pages.title: Not in this world
pages.text:
Two Alex's Caves rides would skip the vehicle game, so they don't exist here.

- **Subterranodon**: the flier never spawns.
- **Submarine**: the Hullbreaker no longer drops the Enigmatic Engine, so you can't build this small sub. Wrecks in the chasm ruins can still be fixed. See [#](2E5AAC)[Getting Around](entry://transport/getting_around)[#]().

[#](FFFFFF)[#]() **In depth.** Alex's Caves sulfur dust is not its own item here. Its recipes (Slam, Spelunkie, Polymer Plate, gunpowder) use TFMG's sulfur dust, and leftover Alex's dust [#](7A3C9A)[converts 1:1](entry://glossary/canonical_item)[#]() in a crafting grid.
